architecture.dormant: unseen candidate with insufficient pair evidence retained but not promoted
architecture.dream: enumerate unseen combinations and score by frozen marginal memory + positive/negative pair resonance
architecture.memory: shrunk marginal state effect relative to visible global mean
architecture.relative_resonance: shrunk pair-state residual beyond marginal expectation, normalized within each position-pair by visible residual dispersion

candidate_domain.allowed_state_per_position: only amino-acid states observed at that position in visible training

dataset: GB1 Wu et al. 2016 four-site landscape
falsification: label-shuffle rerun after primary reveal; should collapse
primary_metrics: best hidden candidate rank percentile within revealed union
source: Hugging Face cleaned GB1 full landscape, derived from eLife Supplementary file 1; visible training rows transcribed from a fixed public 5k superset before hidden reveal
